text:
`python3 -m unittest` now passes: all 16 tests, with the tests untouched. I made seven small fixes in `catalog/`:

- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an int. This also fixed the `age()` error.
- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from a module that doesn't exist, `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports it from `catalog.text`.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3 and is now 5. The comment above it already said five.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` used the slice `[-n - 1:]`, which returned one event too many. It is now `[-n:]`.
- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` added the daily fee to the number of days instead of multiplying. It now multiplies.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing a third book. I added `Book("Emma", "Austen", 1815, 1)`. The tests only check the title, so the author, year and copy count are my choice.
